run_kernel_analyzer_lsp: run the kernel-analyzer language server as an LSP process using stdio transport
validate_python_document: validate a Python document against type annotations and publish diagnostics via the kernel analyzer LSP
fix_type_mismatch: fix a TypeMismatch diagnostic by replacing the annotation with the expected type
fix_invalid_param_order: fix an InvalidParamOrder diagnostic by reordering function parameters to the expected order
initialize_kernel_analyzer_server: initialize the kernel-analyzer LSP server with text document sync and diagnostic provider capabilities
